steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Installation transforms a whole space — the viewer physically enters the artwork, becoming part of the experience. | Key Fact: Mixed media combines different materials and processes in one piece — breaking down boundaries between art forms. | Key Fact: Found objects (ready-mades) bring existing meaning and context — Duchamp's Fountain challenged what counts as art. | Key Fact: Site-specific work responds to a particular location — its architecture, history, atmosphere or community.
